prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: Chaos, a colossal primordial titan of cracked black obsidian standing on two thick legs, a massive muscular humanoid body; exactly four arms, two on each side: on the left side of the image an upper arm and a lower arm, on the right side of the image an upper arm and a lower arm, each ending in a huge clawed stone hand; great tattered wings of shadow-flame (smoke-black membranes edged with purple flame) half raised behind the shoulders, their tips well below the top of the grey box; a heavy horned crown of obsidian growing from the head with two great curved horns; a stern face of cracked stone with two burning white eyes; glowing seams run through the cracks of the body in four colours: frost cyan, ember orange, abyss teal and storm white; palette of obsidian black, deep purple and the four seam colours. FACE: the cracked obsidian face with two burning white eyes under the horned crown is readable.

Pose: idle, a ready battle stance, facing right.

BODY: standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, goat legs, hooves, a tail, snakes, a cape, a weapon, fur, two arms, six arms, a second head.
